test_title: PYST 65: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 26 Feb, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

Napoleon was one of the most capable generals in ____ history.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the omission of the article "**the**" before the term "**history**."
 
• Definite articles **("the") **are used to refer to something specific or known.
 
• In this context,** "the"** is appropriate because it specifies the particular history we are referring to.
 
• Thus, the correct sentence should be "Napoleon was one of the most capable generals in **the** history."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Napoleon was one of the most capable generals in **the** history."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "a"** – This article is indefinite and not suitable for this context.
 
• **Option 3: "an"** – This article is indefinite and used before vowels, not applicable here.
 
• **Option 4: No article** – Omitting the article makes the sentence grammatically incorrect.
